prompt: Research the current state of solid-state batteries and write it up as a Word report. Use green as the main color.
assertions: A .docx file was produced and opens with python-docx
Font is 맑은 고딕 for title and body
Title and headings use a green main color
Lists at least 5 distinct source URLs
Uses inline [n] citations at least 3 times
No raw Markdown syntax in the text
No more empty paragraphs than tables (no stray blank lines)
